subject.title: fix(agents): repair double-escaped JSON strings in tool call argument…

question: Should OpenClaw accept an unconditional, all-provider repair that may reinterpret selected literal escape sequences in tool-call arguments when the code-block signature matches?
rationale: The remaining question is a deliberate cross-provider compatibility policy choice, not a mechanically provable defect in the current patch.

options.title: Accept the all-provider repair
options.body: Merge the constrained wrapper as the canonical protection for the linked cross-provider corruption report, accepting its narrowly tested heuristic behavior.

options.title: Limit activation by provider or API
options.body: Keep the repair behind a proven affected-provider/API gate until broader production evidence establishes that all providers need it.
